formats.name: GeoTIFF
formats.boundary: Classic TIFF and BigTIFF georeferencing over the shared TIFF decoder.

remote-open.detail: Opens HTTP Range sources without full download.

range-access.detail: TIFF tags, strips, and tiles use bounded source ranges.

region-read.detail: Native strips and tiles satisfy bounded pixel regions.

multiscale.detail: Top-level IFD and SubIFD levels retain explicit geometry.

rotated-affine.detail: ModelTransformation and rotated level geometry are preserved.

pixel-is-area.detail: RasterPixelIsArea maps to the shared registration model.

pixel-is-point.detail: RasterPixelIsPoint maps to the shared registration model.

unknown-crs.detail: Incomplete CRS evidence remains explicit and readable.

bands.detail: RGB, four-band, signed, and floating samples retain component metadata.

time-dimension.detail: TIFF pages are not exposed as a time axis by the GeoTIFF reader.

vertical-dimension.detail: Vertical CRS evidence is preserved, but no vertical array axis is synthesized.

nodata.detail: GDAL nodata is normalized into grid and band metadata.

scale-offset.detail: Bounded GDAL metadata is retained without inventing sample scaling.

target-grid-read.detail: GeoTIFF datasets use the shared bounded target-grid read.

reprojection.detail: Caller-supplied coordinate transforms can inverse-map requested output regions.

writer.detail: The public geo reader is read-only.

formats.name: COG behavior
formats.boundary: Selective HTTP Range behavior and structural diagnostics, not formal COG certification.

remote-open.detail: Remote COG-shaped sources open through HTTP Range.

range-access.detail: Requests, transferred bytes, unique bytes, and cache activity are reported.

region-read.detail: Viewport reads fetch intersecting native tiles or strips.

multiscale.detail: SubIFD overviews are selectable with per-level geometry.

rotated-affine.detail: Rotated base and overview transforms are retained.

pixel-is-area.detail: Area registration is tested with COG-shaped fixtures.

pixel-is-point.detail: Point registration is supported by GeoTIFF normalization; the COG corpus is limited.

unknown-crs.detail: Unknown CRS stays explicit; the remote COG corpus is limited.

bands.detail: Component and color layout follow the GeoTIFF reader.

time-dimension.detail: COG behavior does not define a time dimension.

vertical-dimension.detail: Vertical CRS metadata may be preserved without a vertical array axis.

nodata.detail: Nodata is retained during bounded viewport reads.

scale-offset.detail: Bounded GDAL metadata is retained without inferred scaling.

target-grid-read.detail: COG-backed datasets can feed bounded target-grid reads.

reprojection.detail: Reprojection uses the shared caller-injected transform contract.

writer.detail: COG writing and certification are not part of the read-only geo core.

formats.name: GeoZarr
formats.boundary: Read-only GeoZarr over the shared generic Zarr substrate and pinned conventions.

local-open.detail: Local directory and ZIP stores are supported.

remote-open.detail: HTTP object-store roots open without unbounded enumeration.

range-access.detail: Metadata, chunks, and shards use bounded object reads.

region-read.detail: Region planning reads only intersecting logical chunks or shards.

multiscale.detail: Arbitrary declared multiscale levels retain ordering and geometry.

rotated-affine.detail: Rotated affine convention metadata is preserved and used.

pixel-is-area.detail: Pixel registration maps to area semantics.

pixel-is-point.detail: Node registration maps to point semantics.

unknown-crs.detail: Missing or incomplete CRS is explicit in descriptors and diagnostics.

bands.detail: Band dimensions remain selectable and are not guessed from component count.

time-dimension.detail: Time indices remain selectable in multidimensional arrays.

vertical-dimension.detail: Vertical indices remain selectable in multidimensional arrays.

nodata.detail: Fill values and represented nodata are normalized during reads.

scale-offset.detail: Represented sample scale and offset are supported; convention fixtures are limited.

target-grid-read.detail: GeoZarr datasets use the shared bounded target-grid read.

reprojection.detail: Cross-CRS reads require a caller-supplied transformer.

writer.detail: GeoZarr mutation and writing are outside this reader.

formats.name: Image plus world file
formats.boundary: TIFF, JPEG, or PNG pixels decoded by existing codecs with bounded sidecar discovery.

local-open.detail: Caller maps and local sibling resources can provide world files and PRJ files.

remote-open.detail: A bounded documented URL resolver can retrieve sibling sidecars.

range-access.detail: Sidecar reads are bounded; pixel access depends on the underlying image codec.

region-read.detail: Geo views expose regions, but some image codecs materialize the decoded image.

multiscale.detail: World files do not define a pyramid.

rotated-affine.detail: All six world-file coefficients, rotations, and signs are retained.

pixel-is-area.detail: World-file pixel-center coordinates are converted to the canonical area affine.

pixel-is-point.detail: World files describe image pixel centers and do not declare point registration.

unknown-crs.detail: A missing PRJ file leaves explicit unknown CRS evidence.

bands.detail: Components come from the selected image codec; geo semantics remain neutral.

time-dimension.detail: Sidecars do not define a time dimension.

vertical-dimension.detail: Sidecars do not define a vertical dimension.

nodata.detail: World files and PRJ files do not define source nodata.

scale-offset.detail: World files do not define sample scale or offset.

target-grid-read.detail: The adapted image uses the shared target-grid path.

reprojection.detail: PRJ-backed data can use a caller-supplied transformer.

writer.detail: Image and sidecar writing are outside the geo reader.

formats.name: ENVI
formats.boundary: Geospatial normalization over the existing scientific ENVI binary decoder.

local-open.detail: Header and binary companion sources open locally.

remote-open.detail: Caller-supplied remote source pairs work; current geo fixtures are local.

range-access.detail: BSQ, BIL, and BIP reads use the shared bounded ENVI source path.

region-read.detail: Selected bands and bounded pixel regions reuse the scientific decoder.

multiscale.detail: ENVI headers do not expose a pyramid in this reader.

rotated-affine.detail: The supported map-info subset does not invent rotation.

pixel-is-area.detail: Supported map info is converted to canonical area geometry.

pixel-is-point.detail: The implemented ENVI map-info subset does not declare point registration.

bands.detail: Band names, wavelengths, wavelength units, and neutral components are retained.

time-dimension.detail: ENVI bands are not reinterpreted as time.

vertical-dimension.detail: ENVI bands are not reinterpreted as a vertical axis.

nodata.detail: Data ignore values are normalized as nodata.

scale-offset.detail: Reflectance scale factors are preserved without copying samples.

target-grid-read.detail: ENVI geo datasets use the shared target-grid path.

reprojection.detail: Cross-CRS work requires caller-supplied coordinate transformation.

writer.detail: ENVI writing is not part of this read-only adapter.

formats.name: Esri ASCII Grid
formats.boundary: Bounded sequential ASCII parsing with explicit non-random-access diagnostics.

local-open.detail: Bounded local byte sources are supported.

remote-open.detail: Remote byte sources can open, but parsing remains sequential.

range-access.detail: The format requires parsing preceding ASCII content unless an external index exists.

region-read.detail: Region results are available after bounded sequential parsing, not direct random access.

multiscale.detail: The format has no pyramid model.

rotated-affine.detail: The header defines one axis-aligned cell size.

pixel-is-area.detail: Corner declarations map to area registration.

pixel-is-point.detail: Center declarations retain their pixel-center evidence during canonical conversion.

unknown-crs.detail: The format contains no CRS and reports it as unknown.

bands.detail: One elevation or scalar component is exposed.

vertical-dimension.detail: Values may represent elevation, but no vertical coordinate axis is defined.

scale-offset.detail: The format does not define sample scale and offset.

target-grid-read.detail: Parsed datasets use the shared bounded target-grid path.

reprojection.detail: Unknown source CRS limits reprojection unless the caller supplies CRS evidence and a transformer.

writer.detail: ASCII Grid writing is outside the read-only geo reader.

formats.name: SRTM HGT
formats.boundary: Exact-size big-endian elevation tiles with validated names or explicit location.

local-open.detail: Standard exact-size local tile sources are supported.

remote-open.detail: Remote range sources can be supplied; the deterministic format fixture is local.

range-access.detail: Requested rows use bounded byte ranges.

region-read.detail: Requested pixel regions read only their source rows.

multiscale.detail: One HGT file contains one resolution.

rotated-affine.detail: HGT tiles use a fixed geographic north-up grid.

pixel-is-area.detail: HGT samples are elevation posts rather than pixel areas.

pixel-is-point.detail: Elevation posts use point registration and north-to-south rows.

unknown-crs.detail: Valid tile locations have an explicit geographic CRS.

bands.detail: One signed elevation component is exposed.

vertical-dimension.detail: Elevation units and void semantics are described without a vertical array axis.

nodata.detail: The SRTM void value is preserved as nodata.

target-grid-read.detail: HGT datasets use the shared target-grid path.

reprojection.detail: A caller-supplied transformer can map the geographic source CRS.

writer.detail: HGT writing is outside the read-only reader.

formats.name: Classic NetCDF / CF
formats.boundary: CDF-1 and CDF-2 with a bounded regular and rectilinear CF subset; no NetCDF4/HDF5.

local-open.detail: Local CDF-1 and CDF-2 sources open without scanning variable data.

remote-open.detail: Remote range-backed sources open from bounded metadata reads.

range-access.detail: Fixed and record variables use checked 64-bit source offsets.

region-read.detail: Fixed-index views read bounded rows from selected variables.

multiscale.detail: The bounded CF reader does not infer multiscale layouts.

rotated-affine.detail: Only regular affine and rectilinear one-dimensional coordinates are accepted.

pixel-is-area.detail: The initial CF subset models coordinate samples as grid nodes.

pixel-is-point.detail: Regular coordinate variables produce point-registered grid geometry.

unknown-crs.detail: Missing or unsupported grid mapping evidence remains explicit.

bands.detail: Band-like dimensions remain selectable without combining unrelated variables.

time-dimension.detail: Time dimensions and bounded calendar evidence remain selectable.

vertical-dimension.detail: Level and depth dimensions retain axis direction and units.

nodata.detail: Fill, missing, and valid-range metadata are normalized.

scale-offset.detail: scale_factor and add_offset are preserved and applied by the view contract.

target-grid-read.detail: Regular CF geo datasets use the shared target-grid path.

reprojection.detail: Supported mapping metadata is separate from caller-supplied transform execution.

writer.detail: NetCDF writing and NetCDF4 are outside this read-only reader.
